description: A small controlled tag-length-value container created for the Sextant test corpus. It exercises a magic signature, a version byte, a record count, and repeating records whose value length is given by a preceding length field.

provenance.origin: Authored by hand for the Sextant project and generated by corpus/tlv/generate.py.
